**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves once the record has been appended (handed off to the underlying write). It does NOT `fsync`<!-- -->, so resolution does not guarantee the bytes have been flushed to durable storage.

## Exceptions

If the underlying I/O operation fails.
